summary: High-performance code intelligence server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph for instant code search and analysis.
usecases: Instant codebase search and navigation across large repositories
Context-aware code completion and snippet generation for LLMs
Semantic code search and dependency analysis for security reviews
ideas: Build a VS Code extension for instant code navigation
Create a RAG pipeline that uses this knowledge graph for semantic search
Integrate with IDE plugins (Cursor, Windsurf) for real-time code assistance
